your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: Keep $396 cash with Boardwalk ahead and no houses available. Unmortgaging isolated properties offers poor returns versus liquidity. P3 must soon exit jail and p4 is at jail: both can hit our three-house oranges. Preserve rent engine and wait.

Spend $300 to raise orange rents to $750/$750/$800, retaining $1246 liquidity. All rivals have little cash; higher rents accelerate liquidation and bankruptcy. Keep houses rather than hotels; no need to unmortgage isolated assets.

Keep $1246 cash and four-house oranges. Rivals are cash-poor; p2 approaches oranges, while p4 must liquidate heavily on another hit. Hotels surrender house control for modest rent gains; isolated unmortgages offer poor returns. Preserve liquidity against p4's hotels.

Retain $1146 and four-house oranges. P4 is jailed and may land on oranges upon release; current rents already force liquidation. Keep liquidity for approaching brown/light-blue hotels rather than marginal hotel upgrades or isolated unmortgages.

Preserve $746 after Connecticut hit. Four-house oranges threaten p4 exiting jail and already exceed weaker rivals' liquidity. Hotels add little relative to reserve; unmortgaging isolated reds or Short Line not worthwhile. Avoid financing opponents via trades.

Keep $746 reserve and four-house oranges. P4 must exit jail soon and faces our $750–800 rents; no need to release houses for hotels. Isolated unmortgages offer weak returns, and trades would finance rivals. Preserve liquidity against p4's developed sets.

Spend $300 for +$200 rent on every orange, retaining $1196 reserve. With 20 bank houses, house denial no longer matters; extra rent accelerates rival liquidation. P4 now owns pinks, so pressure matters more than hoarding houses.

Retain $1196 liquidity against p4's hotel corridor. Orange hotels now charge $950/$950/$1000; isolated unmortgages give little return. Avoid funding p3's dark blues or p4's pink development through trades.
Stay sheltered in jail while orange hotels collect. No unowned properties and p4 controls dangerous developed sets; paying to move offers little benefit. P3 and p4 approach our oranges.
Stay in jail for safety while orange hotels threaten p4, now at Electric Company. No unowned assets justify paying to move; preserve cash to develop inherited red or dark-blue monopolies later.

final_action.private_thought: Roll rather than voluntarily pay $50. Jail shelters us from developed pinks; on this third attempt a failed roll likely forces payment and movement anyway. Preserve cash for liquidity and developing inherited monopolies.
